id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

trackingIdForImport.description: This ID is used to determine which import this entity belongs to.

from.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} this relation comes from.

to.description: The {@link PhysicalAsset} this relation connects to. Could be a {@link ReliabilityAsset} or a {@link Sensor}.

relationship.description:
Relationship between the parent asset and child asset. For example, position of the asset with respect to the parent asset:
An aircraft(PhysicalAsset) can have 2 wings, Left Wing(position='left') and Right Wing(position='right'),
which are both also PhysicalAssets that a level below in the tree structure representing the
PhysicalAsset Hierarchical System

fromInfo.description: Additional info for the 'from' vertex can be stored here

toInfo.description: Additional info for the 'to' vertex can be stored here

involvement.description: Placeholder field. Not used in regular computation

start.description: Start timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be beginning-of-time (BOT).

end.description: End timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be end-of-time (EOT).

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

title: Represents the relationship between a {@link ReliabilityAsset} and a child {@link ReliabilityAsset} or {@link Sensor}. Acts as the edge in the hierarchy denorm graph.
name: ReliabilityAssetHierarchicalRelation
